Monitoring is live only with both (K13); without either, find out why before §9 (the Grafana rule's state history shows whether it fired and what the contact point answered).

````markdown
## 9. Report-mode soak

Clarification K12: an owner moves to repair mode only after it ran in report mode for at least 24 hours since its last restart, with at least one promotion of each of its SI tables, `sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables` 0 throughout and `sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_fsm_unavailable_total` flat since the leader replacement. Each owner's soak ends no earlier than 24 hours after the later of its restart (`$si_backup/restart-<x>`) and §8's sync, so that VictoriaMetrics holds the whole window; the soaks of both owners run at the same time. A finding during the soak stops the plan for that owner until it is explained; if the host restarts meanwhile (for any reason), its soak starts over: move `$si_backup/restart-<x>` and `$si_backup/audit-<x>-soak.txt` aside (`mv` each to a name with the UTC time appended), run §5's read-only block of that host again to record the new start, and sample and count again from there.

First the tables each owner must promote, read-only (the Active tables come from the table registry, because a table never promoted has no partition state):

```bash
{
  for x in a b; do
    read -r rec_started rec_restarts rec_seq < "$si_backup/restart-$x"
    si_partstates "$x" > "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak-start.jsonl" 2> "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak-start.txt"; cat "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak-start.txt"
    echo "indexer-$x restarted $rec_started at promotion $rec_seq; its Active tables: $(si_active_tables "$x" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "indexer-$x Active tables not promoted since: $(si_unpromoted "$x" "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak-start.jsonl" "$rec_seq" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  done
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/soak-tables.txt"
```

Expected: indexer-a's "not promoted since" list is empty (its acceptance writes of §5.1 and §6 promoted `devnet101.swap_new2`; another indexer-a table on the list needs one write by its owner during the soak, or the plan is amended for it); indexer-b's names every Active table of indexer-b, or nothing when it holds none. indexer-b gets a soak table of its own either way, so that its audit sees promotions: `devuser1`'s owner creates `devuser1.s3_p0` and writes two rows through its own local agent (`si_agent_start`, §0 of the stage-2 runbook). The `devuser1` blocks of §9 to §11 are the user's own: the user runs each in their own terminal (a `bash` session with §0 defined; from fish, run `bash` first), with `key_file` set there; the key never leaves that terminal and never appears in chat. Each other listed table of indexer-b needs one write by its owner as well. First the table:

Confirm before running.

```bash
key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key
{
  si_track 1
  si_agent_start "$key_file"
  si_agent_ch --database devuser1 --query 'CREATE TABLE s3_p0 (id UInt64, v String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id'
  si_agent_stop
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/s3p0-create.txt"
```

Then the read-only wait for the table:

```bash
{
  for n in $(seq 1 60); do s="$(si_status b devuser1 s3_p0 | jq -r .status)"; echo "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S) $s"; [ "$s" = active ] && break; sleep 15; done
  si_status a devuser1 s3_p0
  si_track 1
  [ "$s" = active ] || { echo "devuser1.s3_p0 did not turn active on indexer-b; stop"; exit 1; }
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/s3p0-active.txt"
```

Then rows 1 and 2, once the table is active:

Confirm before running.

```bash
key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key
{
  [ "$(si_status b devuser1 s3_p0 | jq -r .status)" = active ] || { echo "devuser1.s3_p0 is not active on indexer-b; run the wait above again"; exit 1; }
  si_agent_start "$key_file"
  base1="$(si_track_published 1)"
  printf '1,a\n2,b\n' | si_agent_ch --time --database devuser1 --query 'INSERT INTO s3_p0 FORMAT CSV'
  si_wait_track 1 "$base1"
  si_agent_ch --database devuser1 --query "SELECT count() FROM s3_p0 SETTINGS SQL_x_read_mode='safe'"
  si_agent_stop
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/s3p0-insert.txt"
```

Expected: `pending` on indexer-b until its transition is published and its SNode has it ready, then `active`, while indexer-a answers `ordinary`; the INSERT prints its duration; `track 1 published <x> -> <y>`; `2` from the safe read. indexer-b's `runs_total{trigger="promotion"}` is now above `0` and its `fsm_unavailable_total` unchanged.

indexer-a's soak promotion, so that its audit also runs on a promotion well inside the window:

Confirm before running.

```bash
si_accept_a_track 3003 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/accept-3003.txt"
```

The local samples, read-only, one per owner every hour for 25 hours (26 samples; run it in a second `bash` session with §0 defined, or in the background; nothing else waits on it, and the verdict below runs once it has ended): each sample appends a `sample <UTC time>` line and that host's six owner-audit series, the `unclean_tables` and `fsm_unavailable_total` lines included, to `audit-<x>-soak.txt`, which the verdict below extends:

```bash
{
  for n in $(seq 1 26); do
    for x in b a; do
      s="$(si_audit "$x" 2>&1)" || s="sample failed: indexer-$x's metrics could not be read"
      printf 'sample %s\n%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$s" >> "$si_backup/audit-$x-soak.txt"
      echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) sample $n indexer-$x: $(printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -E '_(unclean_tables|fsm_unavailable_total) |^sample failed' | tr '\n' ' ')"
    done
    [ "$n" = 26 ] || sleep 3600
  done
} 2>&1 | tee -a "$si_backup/soak-sampling.txt"
```

Expected: one line per owner and hour, each with `unclean_tables 0` and `fsm_unavailable_total` at its value after the leader replacement. A sample with `unclean_tables` above 0 is a finding: stop for that owner (above).

Then, once the sampling has ended and at least 24 hours have passed, the end of the soak, read-only, one verdict per owner (indexer-b first), appended to that owner's `audit-<x>-soak.txt`. The block passes an owner only if its host did not restart, the window covers 24 hours, VictoriaMetrics never saw an unclean table or a ClickHouse restart in it, the audit never left report mode, at least two local samples were taken and every one is clean and flat, the local counters agree, the host's log carries no unclean line, `fsm_unavailable_total` is where the leader replacement left it, and every Active table was promoted since the restart without a partition left `inventory_unrefreshed`:

```bash
now="$(date -u +%s)"; mon="$(cat "$si_backup/monitoring-synced-at")"; leader_at="$(cat "$si_backup/leader-replaced-at")"
for x in b a; do
  samples="$(grep -E '^sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_(unclean_tables|fsm_unavailable_total) ' "$si_backup/audit-$x-soak.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  {
    ok=1; fail() { echo "indexer-$x: $*"; ok=0; }
    rel="sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x"; sel="network=\"devnet2-si-v2\",release=\"$rel\""
    read -r rec_started rec_restarts rec_seq < "$si_backup/restart-$x"
    read -r started restarts < <(si_host_started "$x")
    [ "$started $restarts" = "$rec_started $rec_restarts" ] || fail "the host restarted after its record ($rec_started $rec_restarts, now $started $restarts): its soak starts over"
    start_s="$(si_epoch "$rec_started")"; from="$start_s"; [ "$mon" -le "$from" ] || from="$mon"
    w=$(( now - from )); echo "indexer-$x: soak window $w s from $(date -u -r "$from" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ 2>/dev/null || date -u -d "@$from" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
    [ "$w" -ge 86400 ] || fail "the window is shorter than 24 hours"
    v="$(si_vm_value "max(max_over_time(sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables{$sel}[${w}s]))")"; echo "max unclean_tables: $v"; [ "$v" = 0 ] || fail "an unclean table during the soak"
    v="$(si_vm_value "min(min_over_time(sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_mode{$sel,mode=\"report\"}[${w}s]))")"; echo "min mode{report}: $v"; [ "$v" = 1 ] || fail "the audit left report mode"
    v="$(si_vm_value "max(increase(sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_clickhouse_restarts_total{$sel}[${w}s]))")"; echo "ClickHouse restarts: $v"; [ "$v" = 0 ] || fail "its ClickHouse restarted during the soak (§13.3)"
    a="$(si_audit "$x")"
    printf 'sample %s (verdict)\n%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$a"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables)" = 0 ] || fail "unclean_tables is not 0 now"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_dropped_twins_total)" = 0 ] || fail "report mode dropped a part"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_clickhouse_restarts_total)" = 0 ] || fail "the SNode counted a ClickHouse restart (§13.3)"
    fsm_now="$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_fsm_unavailable_total || true)"
    if [ "$start_s" -gt "$leader_at" ]; then fsm_base=0; else fsm_base="$(si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_fsm_unavailable_total < "$si_backup/audit-$x-after-leader.txt" || true)"; fi
    echo "fsm_unavailable_total: $fsm_base after the leader replacement, $fsm_now now"; [ "$fsm_now" = "$fsm_base" ] || fail "fsm_unavailable_total moved since the leader replacement"
    count="$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | grep -c '_unclean_tables ' || true)"
    echo "local samples: $count, unclean values $(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | sed -n 's/^.*_unclean_tables //p' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '), fsm_unavailable values $(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | sed -n 's/^.*_fsm_unavailable_total //p' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
    [ "$count" -ge 2 ] || fail "fewer than two local samples in audit-$x-soak.txt: run the sampling block first"
    bad="$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | sed -n 's/^.*_unclean_tables //p' | grep -vx 0 || true)"; [ -z "$bad" ] || fail "a local sample saw an unclean table"
    bad="$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | sed -n 's/^.*_fsm_unavailable_total //p' | grep -vxF "$fsm_base" || true)"; [ -z "$bad" ] || fail "a local sample's fsm_unavailable_total differs from $fsm_base"
    n="$(si_kubectl logs "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-0" -c sentio-node --since-time="$rec_started" | grep -c 'owner audit: hg_safe partition is unclean' || true)"
    echo "unclean log lines since the restart: $n"; [ "$n" = 0 ] || fail "the host logged an unclean partition"
    si_partstates "$x" > "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak.jsonl" 2> "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak.txt"; cat "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak.txt"
    stale="$(si_unpromoted "$x" "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak.jsonl" "$rec_seq")"
    [ -z "$stale" ] || fail "Active tables without a promotion since the restart: $(printf '%s\n' "$stale" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    unref="$(jq -r 'select(.inventory_unrefreshed) | "\(.table_id)/\(.partition_id)"' "$si_backup/partstates-$x-soak.jsonl")"
    [ -z "$unref" ] || fail "partitions with inventory_unrefreshed: $(printf '%s\n' "$unref" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    if [ "$ok" = 1 ]; then echo "indexer-$x soak passed"; else echo "indexer-$x soak FAILED"; fi
  } 2>&1 | tee -a "$si_backup/audit-$x-soak.txt"
done
```

Expected: `indexer-b soak passed` and `indexer-a soak passed`, each after a window of at least `86400 s`, with `max unclean_tables: 0`, `min mode{report}: 1`, `ClickHouse restarts: 0`, `fsm_unavailable_total` equal on both sides, at least two local samples, all with `unclean_tables` 0 and `fsm_unavailable_total` at the same value, and `0` unclean log lines (if the log no longer reaches back to the restart, VictoriaMetrics' answer stands for the window it covers). `FAILED` with a reason: that owner does not move to repair mode; explain the finding first (§13.2 for `unresolved_intent`, §13.3 for a ClickHouse restart), then soak again. The last verdict line of `audit-<x>-soak.txt` is the one §10 reads.

## 10. Repair mode

Per owner, indexer-b first (it owns only track 1 and serves no verifier), each in its own window, and only under K12's preconditions, which the first block of each subsection checks: every voter on `<ARBITER_DIGEST>` (the leader serves `GetPartitionStates`), the deployed-image mechanics run recorded (§1.3), that owner's soak passed (§9) without a restart since, every Active table of that owner promoted since its restart, and no partition of that owner `inventory_unrefreshed`; the block refreshes `partstates-<x>.jsonl` (first written by §7) for that check. In repair mode the SNode drops a resurrected equal-hash twin without an acknowledged name with `ALTER TABLE … DROP PART` (irreversible per part, counted in `dropped_twins_total`) when the drops leave the partition exactly equal to the reference, and holds a table whose audit is not clean not-ready: the host answers it Pending (733, retryable) with its schema (K11) and the SNode builds no shadow for it, until a re-audit (every five seconds) is clean. After its restart the host answers its tables Pending until the startup audit has completed, usually within seconds.

### 10.1 indexer-b

The preconditions, read-only:

```bash
{
  ok=1; fail() { echo "indexer-b: $*"; ok=0; }
  digest="$(sed -n 2p "$si_backup/pins")"
  [ "$(si_images | awk '$1 ~ /^storage-integrity-si-v2-arbiter-/ {sub(/.*@/, "", $3); print $3}' | sort -u)" = "$digest" ] || fail "not every voter runs $digest"
  [ "$(wc -l < "$si_backup/mechanics-record.txt" | tr -d ' ')" = 2 ] || fail "no deployed-image mechanics record (§1.3)"
  [ "$(grep -E '^indexer-b soak (passed|FAILED)$' "$si_backup/audit-b-soak.txt" | tail -n 1)" = 'indexer-b soak passed' ] || fail "the last soak verdict of §9 is not a pass"
  read -r rec_started rec_restarts rec_seq < "$si_backup/restart-b"
  [ "$(si_host_started b)" = "$rec_started $rec_restarts" ] || fail "the host restarted after its soak"
  si_partstates b > "$si_backup/partstates-b.jsonl" 2> "$si_backup/partstates-b.txt"; cat "$si_backup/partstates-b.txt"
  unref="$(jq -r 'select(.inventory_unrefreshed) | "\(.table_id)/\(.partition_id)"' "$si_backup/partstates-b.jsonl")"
  [ -z "$unref" ] || fail "partitions with inventory_unrefreshed: $(printf '%s\n' "$unref" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  si_active_tables b | tee "$si_backup/active-tables-b.txt"
  stale="$(si_unpromoted b "$si_backup/partstates-b.jsonl" "$rec_seq")"
  [ -z "$stale" ] || fail "Active tables without a promotion since the restart: $(printf '%s\n' "$stale" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  si_audit b
  [ "$(si_audit b | si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables)" = 0 ] || fail "unclean_tables is not 0"
  if [ "$ok" = 1 ]; then echo "indexer-b meets the repair preconditions (K12)"; else echo "indexer-b does NOT meet the repair preconditions"; fi
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/repair-preconditions-b.txt"
```

Expected: `indexer-b meets the repair preconditions (K12)`. Anything else: stop.

One commit: `ownerAudit: repair` under `storageIntegrity.snode` in `k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/sentio-node-indexer-b-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml` with `DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT["sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b"] = "repair"` in `test_render.py`.

{

  digest="$(sed -n 2p "$si_backup/pins")"

## 12. Rollback

Every component returns to its previous image: nothing in this runbook changed consensus state, and `v0.12.0` restores what `<ARBITER_TAG>` wrote (§3). Revert in reverse order of the commits: indexer-a's repair, indexer-b's repair, the monitoring commit, indexer-b's image, indexer-a's image, then the verifier commit, then replace the voters back. A step that has not run has no commit file, and its block reverts nothing. Each revert and each voter replacement is confirmed on its own. The repair-mode `DROP PART`s and §13.2's are not undone by anything: each dropped only a resurrected twin, whose data its acknowledged twin still holds. This section holds until the lockdown runbook (`docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-lockdown.md`) begins; once a host has a ClickHouse login, roll the lockdown back first (its §12), because a host below sentio-node `<SN_COMMIT>` ignores its login and cannot connect once `default` is locked.

To take one owner back to report mode only (for a held table under investigation, or any doubt about repair mode), run that owner's repair block below and stop there; it keeps the stage-3 image. Reverting indexer-b's repair commit while indexer-a's is still on `main` conflicts (their two `DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT` lines in `test_render.py` are adjacent), so `si_revert_stage3` aborts that revert and changes nothing: revert indexer-a's repair commit first (one more restart of indexer-a, which returns to report mode too), then indexer-b's.

## 13. Operating rules

These extend §11 of the stage-2 runbook and of the stage-1 runbook, which stay in force except where noted.

- The owner audit has two modes. Report (the default) audits, logs at error level and counts, but never drops a part or holds a table. Repair drops resurrected equal-hash twins without an acknowledged name (irreversible per part; `dropped_twins_total`, alert `SentioNodeOwnerAuditDroppedTwins`) and holds an unclean table Pending (733) with its schema until a re-audit is clean (`SentioNodeOwnerAuditHoldingTables`). Never switch an owner back to report mode only to release a held table: read the finding first (`owner audit: hg_safe partition is unclean`, fields `reason`, `parts`, `twins`, `reference`), and take an owner back to report mode (§12) only while the finding is investigated.
- An unreachable arbiter never holds a table (K3): the audit falls back to the SNode's own acknowledged inventory and counts `fsm_unavailable_total` (`SentioNodeOwnerAuditFSMUnavailable`); only a partition with parts and no reference at all is unclean (`no_acknowledged_inventory`).
- A peer refusal (`storage_integrity_peer_reserved_name_refusals_total{reason}` above 0, `StorageIntegrityPeerReservedNameRefused`) carries the warn log `peer statement refused by storage-integrity reserved-name guard` with the reason, the reserved name, the peer address and the statement. A refused leg of a legitimate cross-indexer read is a HouseGate defect to report; a tenant object named after a reserved name is renamed by its owner (§2).
- The chart's alerts reach a human only through the Grafana rule of §8; vmalert notifies nobody. Keep that rule while `devnet2-si-v2` runs, and repeat §8's probe after any change to it, to its contact point or to the `#alerts` policy. The alert set is the reviewed `MONITORING_ALERTS` of `test_render.py`; a new alert goes through a reviewed PR.
- Never run a voter or verifier below `v0.12.0` or a host below sentio-node `5d2f1695e33d911cb642bf60b49b71cdb74f62a0` (the stage-2 rules); within those, every P0 component may return to its previous image (§12) until the lockdown runbook begins.

### 13.1 State size and voter resize

L = min(1 GiB snapshot read cap, voter memory limit / 4, voter volume / 4) = 536870912 bytes (512 MiB) for the pinned 2Gi voters (spec §13.1, K14); `monitoring.stateLimitBytes` must equal it, and the chart refuses any other value. Thresholds: warn at L/4 = 134217728 bytes (`ArbiterStateSizeHigh`, `ArbiterRaftStorageHigh`), page at L/2 = 268435456 bytes (`ArbiterStateSizeCritical`, `ArbiterRaftStorageCritical`), and finish a resize before 3L/4 = 402653184 bytes. The memory alerts read `arbiter_state_bytes` (the uncompacted canonical encoding of the state); the volume alerts read `arbiter_snapshot_doc_bytes` plus `arbiter_raft_log_store_bytes` (bolt's `raft.db` never shrinks). `ArbiterSnapshotDocNearReadCap` fires above half the 1 GiB read cap, past which a voter can no longer restore or install a snapshot. The gauges refresh only when a snapshot is persisted or restored (every `snapshot_threshold` entries, 8192), so read them with `si_state_size`, never infer them from the log. The measured state (about 12 MB) is about 2 % of L/4. `local-path` enforces no volume size: the real budget is the node SSD shared with other volumes; watch its free space as well.

A resize is a procedure for its own reviewed window, rehearsed first, and is not part of this runbook's run (K14). Memory: one values commit raising `arbiter.resources.limits.memory` and `monitoring.stateLimitBytes` together (to the new L), synced (the voters are `OnDelete`, so no pod moves), then `si_replace_voter` for the two followers and the leader last, as in §6; reversible the same way. Volume, irreversible per voter on `local-path` (no expansion: the volume is deleted and the voter rejoins empty by an InstallSnapshot from the leader): back up every voter's `raft` directory as §3.3 copies it; one values commit raising `arbiter.storageSize` and `monitoring.stateLimitBytes` together (L follows the smallest of the three terms); `si_kubectl delete statefulset storage-integrity-si-v2-arbiter --cascade=orphan` right before the sync, because volume claim templates are immutable; then one voter at a time, never the leader, and ordinal 0 (which renders `bootstrap: true`) only while 1 and 2 are healthy and agree: `si_kubectl delete pvc data-storage-integrity-si-v2-arbiter-<i> --wait=false`, `si_kubectl delete pod storage-integrity-si-v2-arbiter-<i> --wait`, then wait until the pod is Ready, its volume Bound at the new size, `arbiter_snapshot_restore_seconds{trigger="install"}` present on it, and the sealed tips agree (`si_replace_voter`'s loop). Never empty two voters at once: two empty voters could elect an empty cluster.

### 13.2 The unresolved-intent step

Clarification K4: a partition whose promotion intent is journaled and not finalized is skipped by the audit and reported `unresolved_intent`; its redelivery reconciles it, but if ClickHouse restarted inside the outdated-part window after the intent's `REPLACE PARTITION`, the parts the REPLACE retired came back active, the partition's root is neither the intent's base nor its post root, and every redelivery fails with `safe partition after unresolved promotion has root <r>, expected base <b> or post <p>`, which stalls that owner's track. There is no automatic repair: this operator step repairs it, by the twin rule, one confirmed `DROP PART` per part. Signal: `unclean_tables` above 0 with that log line or `reason=unresolved_intent` in `owner audit: hg_safe partition is unclean`.

First the evidence, read-only. Set the owner, the table id (`<database>.<table>`) and the partition id from the log line:

```bash
x=a; table_id='<table id>'; partition_id='<partition id>'
case "$x$table_id$partition_id" in *'<'*) echo "set x, table_id and partition_id from the finding first"; exit 1;; esac
tag="$x-$(printf '%s' "$table_id-$partition_id" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '_')"
{
  si_audit "$x"
  si_kubectl logs "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-0" -c sentio-node --since=2h | grep -E 'owner audit: hg_safe partition is unclean|safe partition after unresolved promotion has root' | tail -n 5 || true
  si_host "$x" cat /data/storage-integrity-devnet2-si-v2/snode/state.json | jq --arg t "$table_id" --arg p "$partition_id" '.promotion_intents[$t + "\u0000" + $p]' > "$si_backup/k4-intent-$tag.json"
  jq -c 'if . == null then "no intent" else {promotion_seq, base_partition_root, post_partition_root, safe_parts_before: [.safe_parts_before[].name]} end' "$si_backup/k4-intent-$tag.json"
  si_source_ch "$x" "SELECT name, hash_of_all_files, rows, modification_time FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'hg_safe' AND table = '$(printf '%s' "$table_id" | sed 's/\./__/g')' AND partition_id = '$partition_id' AND active ORDER BY name FORMAT TSV" > "$si_backup/k4-parts-$tag.tsv"
  cat "$si_backup/k4-parts-$tag.tsv"
  python3 -I - "$si_backup/k4-intent-$tag.json" "$si_backup/k4-parts-$tag.tsv" "$si_backup/k4-twins-$tag.txt" <<'EOF'
import json, sys
intent = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
if not intent:
    sys.exit("no promotion intent is journaled for this partition: not the K4 case; stop and escalate")
before = {p["name"] for p in intent.get("safe_parts_before") or []}
parts = [line.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for line in open(sys.argv[2]) if line.strip()]
replacement = {row[1] for row in parts if row[0] not in before}
resurrected = [(row[0], row[1]) for row in parts if row[0] in before]
twins = [name for name, phys in resurrected if phys in replacement]
others = [name for name, phys in resurrected if phys not in replacement]
print("resurrected parts:", [name for name, _ in resurrected])
print("twins:", twins)
if not resurrected or others:
    sys.exit("not every resurrected part has an equal-hash twin among the replacement parts (%s): no repair by this step (K4); stop and escalate" % (others or "nothing resurrected"))
open(sys.argv[3], "w").write("".join(name + "\n" for name in twins))
print("every extra active part is a resurrected twin: drop each with the next block, one part per run")
EOF
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/k4-evidence-$tag.txt"
```

The twin rule: a part is a resurrected twin only if its name is in the intent's `safe_parts_before` (the inventory the REPLACE retired) and another active part, outside `safe_parts_before`, has the same `hash_of_all_files` (its replacement copy, which the shadow ATTACHed byte for byte). Only when every extra active part is such a twin does the block write the twin list; anything else is escalated, never repaired here. Then one block per part on the list, each confirmed on its own:

Confirm before running.

```bash
x=a; table_id='<table id>'; partition_id='<partition id>'; part='<one part name from the twin list>'
case "$x$table_id$partition_id$part" in *'<'*) echo "set x, table_id, partition_id and part first"; exit 1;; esac
tag="$x-$(printf '%s' "$table_id-$partition_id" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '_')"
grep -qxF "$part" "$si_backup/k4-twins-$tag.txt" || { echo "$part is not on k4-twins-$tag.txt: never drop a part the twin rule did not name"; exit 1; }
! grep -qxF "$part" "$si_backup/k4-dropped-$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null || { echo "$part was dropped already"; exit 1; }
si_source_ch "$x" "ALTER TABLE hg_safe.$(printf '%s' "$table_id" | sed 's/\./__/g') DROP PART '$part'"
echo "$part" >> "$si_backup/k4-dropped-$tag.txt"
```

Before the lockdown `si_source_ch` connects as the passwordless `default` (stage-1 §0); the lockdown runbook redefines it over its admin helper with the same signature. Then watch the next redelivery finalize the intent, read-only and repeatable:

```bash
{
  x=a
  si_audit "$x"
  si_host "$x" cat /data/storage-integrity-devnet2-si-v2/snode/state.json | jq -c '.promotion_intents // {} | keys | map(split("\u0000"))'
  si_tracks | jq -c '[.indexers[] | {id: .indexer_id, prefix: .prefix_block_seq, published: .published.safe_block_seq}]'
} 2>&1 | tee -a "$si_backup/k4-watch.txt"
```

Expected: the partition's intent leaves `promotion_intents`, `unclean_tables` returns to 0 and that owner's track advances again. If it does not within a few dispatch retries, stop and escalate.

### 13.3 ClickHouse restarts

After a `REPLACE PARTITION` the retired parts stay on disk as outdated parts for `old_parts_lifetime` (480 s); a ClickHouse restart inside that window brings them back active (Plan S3-A M3). Never restart an owner's ClickHouse (a CHI change that restarts pods, a node drain, a pod deletion) while it is in report mode with REPLACE-retired parts in that window: report mode would only count the resurrection, and the next promotion of that partition fails closure and stalls that owner's track until repair mode or §13.2 fixes it. In repair mode the audit drops the twins on its own (`StorageIntegrityClickHouseRestarted`, then `dropped_twins_total`), but wait anyway. Before any planned restart of a source ClickHouse, this read-only check must list no inactive `hg_safe` part:

```bash
for x in a b; do
  echo "indexer-$x: old_parts_lifetime $(si_source_ch "$x" "SELECT value FROM system.merge_tree_settings WHERE name = 'old_parts_lifetime'") s; inactive hg_safe parts:"
  si_source_ch "$x" "SELECT table, partition_id, count() FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'hg_safe' AND NOT active GROUP BY table, partition_id ORDER BY table, partition_id FORMAT TSV"
  si_audit "$x" | grep -E 'owner_audit_mode|clickhouse_restarts_total' || true
done 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/clickhouse-restart-check-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).txt"
```

Expected before a restart: `480 s` and no row. After an unplanned restart, read `clickhouse_restarts_total` and `runs_total{trigger="clickhouse_restart"}` (one more each) and `unclean_tables`; a finding is handled as above.

### 13.4 Promotion budget for drills

Every promotion grows the consensus state (spec §13.1; the super-linear term comes from the parts each `REPLACE PARTITION` renames). Before a drill that writes in a loop, compute its promotion budget and spend at most half of it; churn drills (many promotions of one partition) run only in the integration environment or on a partitioned throwaway table. One sample per run, read-only (time, the leader's state bytes, its snapshot document bytes and the promotion sequence; the gauges are from the last snapshot, so take samples at least one snapshot apart):

```bash
l="$(si_leader)"
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(si_state_size "$l" | si_series_value arbiter_state_bytes)" "$(si_state_size "$l" | si_series_value arbiter_snapshot_doc_bytes)" "$(si_show | jq -r .promotion_seq)" | tee -a "$si_backup/state-samples.tsv"
```

Then the budget, local only:

```bash
python3 -I - "$si_backup/state-samples.tsv" 536870912 <<'EOF'
import math, sys
rows = [line.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for line in open(sys.argv[1]) if line.strip()]
limit = int(sys.argv[2])
target = limit // 4
samples = sorted({int(r[3]): int(r[1]) for r in rows}.items())
seq, state = samples[-1]
# The state grows about quadratically in the promotion count (spec §2: 11.4 MB at promotion 53), so the
# marginal cost of a promotion is about twice the average: never divide the headroom by an average.
estimates = []
if seq > 0:  # pure quadratic through the origin: S = a*n^2 (overstates a, so it understates the budget)
    a0 = state / seq ** 2
    estimates.append(("quadratic through the latest sample", math.isqrt(int(target / a0)) - seq))
if len(samples) >= 2:  # S = c + a*n^2 through the first and the latest sample
    (n1, s1), (n2, s2) = samples[0], samples[-1]
    if n2 > n1 and s2 > s1:
        a = (s2 - s1) / (n2 ** 2 - n1 ** 2)
        c = s2 - a * n2 ** 2
        if target > c:
            estimates.append(("quadratic fit of the first and latest samples", math.isqrt(int((target - c) / a)) - seq))
if not estimates or state >= target:
    print("state %d bytes at promotion %d: no promotion budget left before L/4; stop" % (state, seq)); sys.exit(1)
how, budget = min(estimates, key=lambda e: e[1])
budget = max(budget, 0)
print("state %d bytes at promotion %d; budget to L/4 (%d bytes): %d promotions (%s, the smaller estimate); a drill spends at most %d"
      % (state, seq, target, budget, how, budget // 2))
EOF
```

Expected: one line with the budget. Both estimates are quadratic and the smaller one is used: a single sample assumes the state grew from zero as a·n², which overstates the growth and so understates the budget; a second sample, taken at least one snapshot later, fits the constant term too. Take a second sample after the drill and keep the file. At devnet2's measured point (about 11.4 MB at promotion 53) this gives about 128 promotions to L/4, where a linear estimate would give about 570.

### 13.5 Holds

- Every consensus update from now on runs `arbiter-admin consensus update` with its default `--hold drain` (K6): the CLI signs a draft, takes the leader's drain hold, waits until it is ready (every track's frontier block promoted, no later block's promotion started), signs the update with the frozen `promotion_seq` and submits it under the hold; any exit before the submit releases the hold. `--hold issuance` can wait forever on a half-promoted multi-partition frontier block and is not used on devnet2. A hold clears on commit, refusal, release, timeout (`consensus_admin.max_drain_mode`, default 10m; `max_issuance_hold`, default 2m) or leadership loss.
- An `arbiter-admin` of `<ARBITER_TAG>` against an older leader refuses with `leader does not support consensus holds (arbiter older than this arbiter-admin); upgrade the leader or pass --hold none`, and `hold-status` and `hold-release` answer the same. Upgrade the leader (§6); `--hold none` is today's unheld flow, which a promotion between the read and the proposal refuses, and is used only when the user decides so for that update.
- `arbiter-admin consensus hold-status --address <leader> --hold-id <id>` prints a hold (the CLI prints the id on stderr when it takes one); `consensus hold-release --address <leader> --hold-id <id>` releases it. Run both inside a voter against the leader's in-cluster address (`si_arbiter`, `si_voter`), as every consensus command here. A hold active longer than the drain should take (`ArbiterConsensusHoldStuck`, `arbiter_consensus_hold_active{mode="drain"} 1`) is read with `hold-status` (its `tracks` show which frontier is not promoted yet) and released; a stuck track is quarantined only on the user's decision (stage-2 runbook §11).
- Holds are leader-local and never reach Raft: a leader change ends every hold (`leadership_lost`), and the CLI then fails without submitting.
````

**Conventions for this task.**
- The live checkout is a clean production checkout at a detached, freshly fetched `origin/main` (decision D4, contract §15): the URWT worktree `multi-source-s3b-p0-live` (Step 1), detached right after it is created. Its branch `urwt/claude/multi-source-s3b-p0-live` is never used or pushed: every commit is made on the detached HEAD and pushed as `HEAD:main` by its runbook block, and `p0_fresh_main` fast-forwards the detached HEAD to `origin/main` and requires it clean, detached and equal to `origin/main` before every commit and every revert. Never run this task from Task 13–14's worktree `multi-source-s3b-p0`, from a phase branch or from the user's own checkout.
- The agent runs every bash block, the runbook's and this task's, from a block file, never inside a heredoc (decision D24): several runbook blocks carry their own `<<'EOF'` heredocs (§8's render diff, selector extraction and probe file, §13.2's twin rule) and this task's carry `<<'PY'` and `<<'SH'`, so no wrapping delimiter is safe. For each run the agent writes, with the Write tool, a new file `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p0/blocks/<nn>-<what>.sh` (`<nn>` counts up in the order the blocks run; a file is never edited or reused once it ran) whose first two lines are

  ```bash
  source "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p0/helpers.sh"
  cd "$P"
  ```

  followed by the block exactly as the live checkout's `docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md` (or this task) gives it, changed only where the block itself names an operator input, and runs it with the Bash tool as `bash -eo pipefail "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p0/blocks/<nn>-<what>.sh" < /dev/null` (the Bash tool's own shell is zsh, so a block never runs in it directly, and no command of a block can read the tool's stdin). `helpers.sh` (Step 1) holds the runbook's §0 helpers, the earlier runbooks' §0 helpers they build on (extracted by their fences, `p0-helpers.py`), this task's `p0_*` helpers, and `P`, the live checkout. A read-only block may run again (from a new file); a confirmed block never does, because a re-run repeats its writes. A block that may wait longer than 10 minutes runs with `run_in_background: true`; read its output before the next step.
- Every mutation waits for an explicit yes in chat, given for that step only, and the step says so in a line of its own: pushes to production `main` and to any branch, `helmfile sync`, voter pod deletions, copying the throwaway `partstates` tool into the voters (`si_partstates_put`, runbook §1.3 and §7), `kubectl apply` and `kubectl delete` of the delivery probe, the runbook's acceptance writes, the docs PRs and their merges, and the housegate ledger commit's push. Before asking, the agent states exactly what will change (the step's "Gate:" sentence). Read-only reads of the cluster, of GitHub and of the registry (`kubectl get`, `logs`, `exec` that only reads, the runbook's read-only blocks, `gh pr view`, `docker buildx imagetools inspect`, `git fetch`) need no confirmation (contract §15 lists the actions that do); each step says which kind it is.
- The user's own actions: the Grafana-managed rule of K13 and reading `#alerts`, in the user's own browser; and the `devuser1` owner's four blocks of runbook §9, §10.1 and §11 (the soak table `devuser1.s3_p0`: create, rows 1–2, row 3, drop; decision D3), each in the user's own terminal. The agent never edits Grafana, never posts to Slack and never runs a `devuser1` block: for each, it states the block's Gate in chat and hands the user one fish command, `bash ~/si-devnet2-stage3-p0/p0-user-block.sh <evidence file> <path to devuser1's owner key file>` (Step 1), which runs exactly that runbook block in bash with the session helpers defined; the key is read only by `si_agent_start` into `HOUSEGATE_AGENT_KEY`, never pasted into chat, put on argv or printed. The agent then reads the block's evidence file under `$si_backup`. The user pastes the two `#alerts` permalinks of the probe into chat (they carry no secret); they are written only under `$si_backup`, never into git.

From Step 7 until Step 16, nothing else changes `storage-integrity-si-v2`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a` or `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b` (no other sync, no pod deletion outside this task); from Step 10 until Step 11 has passed, no other voter change. Locally irreversible: every `DROP PART` that repair mode issues on `hg_safe` from Step 14 on, and a K4 operator `DROP PART` of runbook §13.2, each confirmed on its own (repair mode's own drops need no confirmation per part: they are what the confirmed repair switch turns on).

`p0-helpers.py`, which assembles the session helpers exactly as each runbook's §0 says to define them:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the session helpers of a devnet2 runbook, earlier runbooks first (Plan S3-B Task 15).

  p0-helpers.py DOCS_DIR RUNBOOK.md

A runbook's "## 0. Session helpers" section names the earlier runbooks whose
§0 helpers it builds on (Markdown links before its first bash block) and then
holds its own helpers in its first bash block (decision D20). This prints,
depth first and each runbook once, the earlier runbooks' first §0 bash blocks
and then the runbook's own, each behind a comment naming its source, exactly
as the runbooks say to define them. Blocks are found by their fences, line by
line (decision D24): a fence opens on a line of three or more backquotes and
closes only on a line of at least as many backquotes and nothing else, so a
line inside a block that mentions backquotes (the stage-3 P0 runbook's
partstates builder) or ends a heredoc never ends the block. Tasks 18 and 21
assemble their helpers with the same code.
"""

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

FENCE = re.compile(r"(`{3,})([^`\s]*)\s*$")


def section_zero(path):
    lines = path.read_text().split("\n")
    if "## 0. Session helpers" not in lines:
        sys.exit(f"p0-helpers: {path} has no '## 0. Session helpers' section")
    intro, block, fence = [], None, None
    for line in lines[lines.index("## 0. Session helpers") + 1:]:
        if fence is None:
            opening = FENCE.match(line)
            if opening:
                fence = opening.group(1)
                if opening.group(2) == "bash":
                    block = []
            elif line.startswith("## "):
                break
            else:
                intro.append(line)
        elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
            if block is not None:
                earlier = re.findall(r"\]\((storage-integrity-devnet2-[a-z0-9-]+\.md)\)", "\n".join(intro))
                return earlier, "\n".join(block) + "\n"
            fence = None
        elif block is not None:
            block.append(line)
    sys.exit(f"p0-helpers: {path}: no complete bash block in section 0")


def collect(docs, name, seen, out):
    if name in seen:
        return
    seen.add(name)
    earlier, block = section_zero(docs / name)
    for other in earlier:
        collect(docs, other, seen, out)
    out.append((name, block))


def main(docs, runbook):
    out = []
    collect(Path(docs), runbook, set(), out)
    for name, block in out:
        print(f"# --- §0 of docs/{name}")
        print(block, end="" if block.endswith("\n") else "\n")
    print("# --- end of runbook helpers: " + " ".join(name for name, _ in out), file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    main(*sys.argv[1:])
```

`p0-k9.py`, which checks Plan S3-A's deployed-image mechanics record (Step 2; the ledger values themselves come from the ledger tool of contract §15):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check Plan S3-A's deployed-image mechanics record (K9) for Task 15 of Plan S3-B.

  p0-k9.py S3A_PLAN OUT_DIR

S3A_PLAN is Plan S3-A's file as the ledger copy holds it (`s3b-ledger.py show
HOUSEGATE s3a`, Step 2). Fails unless its Appendix C records both PASS lines
that Plan S3-A Task 6's scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh prints on the
deployed image (K9, decision D6), exactly as that script prints them; writes
them to OUT_DIR/k9-record.txt and prints them. The ledger values come from
`s3b-ledger.py get` (contract §15), never from this file.
"""

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# K9: the manual run on the deployed image, never CI's upstream clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3.
# These are the two lines scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh (Plan S3-A Task 6) prints on success,
# verbatim; runbook §1.3 greps for the same two strings.
DEPLOYED_IMAGE = "us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/sentio-352722/sentio/clickhouse-server:26.3-lts-decimal512-release-2026-09-16"
K9_LINES = (
    f"mechanics: 13 test(s) passed on {DEPLOYED_IMAGE}",
    f"snode: TestOwnerAuditRepairsResurrectedPartsAcrossAClickHouseRestart passed on {DEPLOYED_IMAGE}",
)


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"p0-k9: {message}")


def main(s3a_plan, out_dir):
    if not Path(s3a_plan).is_file():
        fail(f"{s3a_plan} does not exist")
    parts = re.split(r"^## Appendix C\b.*$", Path(s3a_plan).read_text(), flags=re.M)
    if len(parts) != 2:
        fail(f"{s3a_plan}: expected one '## Appendix C' heading, found {len(parts) - 1}")
    section = re.split(r"^## ", parts[1], flags=re.M)[0]
    missing = [line for line in K9_LINES if line not in section]
    if missing:
        fail(f"{s3a_plan}: Appendix C does not record the deployed-image mechanics run (K9) of "
             f"Plan S3-A Task 6; missing: {missing}")
    (Path(out_dir) / "k9-record.txt").write_text("".join(line + "\n" for line in K9_LINES))
    print("K9: " + "\nK9: ".join(K9_LINES))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    main(*sys.argv[1:])
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3

Run from the root of a clean production checkout at origin/main. Every edit is

refuses unless its anchor matches exactly once; afterwards the parsed YAML of

  p0-edit.py host a|b SN_COMMIT SN_DIGEST HG_TAG CORE_TAG

ARBITER_PIN = """\

    # arbiter {tag} ({commit}), pinned here rather than in the

    # runtime unreviewed. It carries arbiter-core {core}, housegate {hg} and the

    # consensus format: the live voters' Raft logs replay identically under
    # v0.12.0 and {tag} (offline statedigest check, {date}), and both
    # builds write and restore the same v20 snapshots. The verifiers
    # (RollingUpdate) move on sync while the voters (OnDelete) keep running
    # v0.12.0 until they are replaced one at a time; see
    # docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md §4 and §6.
    # Previous pin, the way back of that runbook's §12: v0.12.0 sha256:14ac64030e49de64afcd7387a2a6a99bf1588bc47e9ea5fbff56ece20f97fe70
    # The tracks activation committed on 2026-10-13 (epoch 5): v0.11.0 and older
    # are no way back. They cannot read the voters' v20 snapshots, and the
    # leader refuses their verifiers at registration; never pin one again.
    digest: {digest}
"""

ARBITER_MIRROR = """\
# The Arbiter runtime devnet2-si-v2 runs. Each arbiter upgrade
# (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md §4 and the runbooks before it)
# changes it together with arbiter.image.digest in storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml.
# Since the tracks activation (2026-10-13) no arbiter release before v0.12.0
# reads the voters' state; stage 3 P0 changes no consensus format, so v0.12.0
# stays its way back (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md §12).
DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST = "{digest}"
"""

PIN_A = """\
# Merged LAST into indexer-a by storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml: the
# embedded source SNode must run arbiter-core v0.8.0 or later; this pin runs
# sentio-node {commit}, the multi-source stage-3 P0 host build (housegate
# spec 2026-10-14 §14): housegate {hg} (the peer-trusted reserved-name guard
# over hg_safe, hg_unsafe, hg_promote, hg_member_unsafe, hg_replica, hg_rstage
# and hg_xfer, and a Pending table that keeps its schema, on top of v0.19.0's
# INDEXER_QUARANTINED refusal and track_frontiers), rewriter-proto/rewriter-go
# as resolved by that build, and arbiter-core {core} (the owner hg_safe audit
# in report and repair modes with ClickHouse restart detection, and the
# stage-3 read client; track_manifests_v1 as before). The host reads
# storage_integrity.snode.owner_audit (storageIntegrity.snode.ownerAudit in
# sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml) and an optional SI
# ClickHouse login (storage_integrity.clickhouse_username, the password only
# from STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD), and exports the owner-audit
# series on :9091. indexer-b runs the same image. Its startup probe needs
# rewriter-grpc v0.17.0 or later, so it moves together with the in-pod
# rewriter pinned in sentio-node-indexer-a-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml.
# Rollback target of docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md §12 (stage 3
# P0 changes no consensus state; revert the repair commit first, and only
# while the default ClickHouse user is open):
# sha-5d2f1695e33d911cb642bf60b49b71cdb74f62a0@sha256:be730c40d68e3de49d0d33c736a001a305b089ef11d1a81f0e883d804e15abaa.
# A copy of the verified input in docs/examples/storage-integrity-fresh-source-image.yaml
# (sentio-node {commit}, official main CI). Keep the two identical; the
# render tests check it.
node:
  image:
    repository: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node
    tag: "sha-{commit}@{digest}"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
"""

PIN_B = """\
# Merged LAST into indexer-b by storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml: the
# multi-source stage-3 P0 host build (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §14),
# sentio-node {commit} on housegate {hg} (the peer-trusted
# reserved-name guard and a Pending table that keeps its schema, on top of
# v0.19.0's INDEXER_QUARANTINED refusal, track_frontiers, lanes, writer
# authorization, denylist and sipeerguard) and arbiter-core {core} (the owner
# hg_safe audit in report and repair modes, ClickHouse restart detection,
# track_manifests_v1). The host reads storage_integrity.snode.owner_audit
# (storageIntegrity.snode.ownerAudit in
# sentio-node-indexer-b-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml) and an optional SI
# ClickHouse login. indexer-a runs the same image
# (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md §5). test_render.py mirrors this
# pin as INDEXER_B_SOURCE_IMAGE and lists it in WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES and
# STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES. Its startup probe needs rewriter-grpc v0.17.0 or later,
# pinned in sentio-node-indexer-b-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml.
# Way back (§12; stage 3 P0 changes no consensus state; revert the repair
# commit first, and only while the default ClickHouse user is open):
# sha-5d2f1695e33d911cb642bf60b49b71cdb74f62a0@sha256:be730c40d68e3de49d0d33c736a001a305b089ef11d1a81f0e883d804e15abaa;
# never run an image without track_manifests_v1 on this node.
node:
  image:
    repository: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node
    tag: "sha-{commit}@{digest}"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
"""

EXAMPLE_PIN = """\
# Merge LAST into a separately reviewed fresh-network sentio-node release.
# This is not a deployment file for legacy devnet2.
# sentio-node {commit}: housegate {hg}, rewriter-proto/rewriter-go as resolved
# by that build, arbiter-core {core} (multi-source stage 3 P0: the owner
# hg_safe audit, the peer-trusted reserved-name guard, the optional SI
# ClickHouse login). Its embedded HouseGate refuses to start against a
# rewriter older than rewriter-grpc v0.17.0.
# Published by official main CI; source revision and the immutable image were
# independently verified. Run validate_source_binding.py against both renders.
node:
  image:
    repository: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node
    tag: "sha-{commit}@{digest}"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
"""

IMAGE_VALUE = """\
{name} = (
    "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-{commit}"
    "@{digest}"
)
"""

INDEXER_B_MIRROR = """\
# The source image of indexer-b's SI release, the multi-source stage-3 P0 host
# build (owner hg_safe audit, peer-trusted reserved-name guard, optional SI
# ClickHouse login). Mirrors
# sentio-node-indexer-b-storage-integrity-si-v2-source-image.yaml; indexer-a
# runs the same image (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md §5).
"""

SCHEMA_SOURCE = "    schemaSource: network_state\n"

REPORT_BLOCK = """\
    # Owner hg_safe audit (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §14; Plan S3-A K1): report
    # audits before every promotion and after every ClickHouse restart, logs
    # and counts, and never drops a part or holds a table back. repair (one
    # owner at a time, indexer-b first: docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md
    # §10) also drops resurrected twins and answers an unclean table Pending
    # (733). Read only by an image in STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES (test_render.py);
    # older images ignore it.
    ownerAudit: report
"""

REPAIR_BLOCK = """\
    # Owner hg_safe audit (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §14; Plan S3-A K1, K12):
    # repair, after the report-mode soak of
    # docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md §9. Before every promotion and
    # after every ClickHouse restart the SNode drops resurrected equal-hash
    # twins without an acknowledged name (DROP PART on hg_safe, irreversible
    # per part) and answers an unclean table Pending (733) with its schema
    # until its audit is clean. Way back: report (revert this commit, §12).
    # Read only by an image in STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES (test_render.py).
    ownerAudit: repair
"""


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"p0-edit: {message}; nothing was changed")


def check(value, pattern, name):
    if not re.fullmatch(pattern, value):
        fail(f"{name} {value!r} does not match {pattern}")
    return value


def read(path):
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{path} is missing: run from the root of a production checkout")
    return path.read_text()


def flatten(node, prefix=()):
    if isinstance(node, dict) and node:
        out = {}
        for key, value in node.items():
            out.update(flatten(value, prefix + (str(key),)))
        return out
    return {prefix: node}


def expect_yaml_changes(path, before, after, expected):
    old, new = flatten(yaml.safe_load(before)), flatten(yaml.safe_load(after))
    changes = {
        ".".join(key): (old.get(key), new.get(key))
        for key in old.keys() | new.keys()
        if old.get(key) != new.get(key)
    }
    if changes != expected:
        fail(f"{path}: the parsed values change by {changes}, expected exactly {expected}")


def assignment(source, name):
    nodes = [
        node for node in ast.parse(source).body
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1
        and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name) and node.targets[0].id == name
    ]
    if len(nodes) != 1:
        fail(f"{TEST_RENDER}: expected one top-level assignment of {name}, found {len(nodes)}")
    return nodes[0]


def literal(source, name):
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(assignment(source, name).value)
    except ValueError:
        fail(f"{TEST_RENDER}: {name} is not a literal")


def replace_assignment(source, name, text, with_comment):
    node = assignment(source, name)
    lines = source.split("\n")
    start = node.lineno - 1
    if with_comment:
        while start > 0 and lines[start - 1].startswith("#"):
            start -= 1
    return "\n".join(lines[:start] + text.rstrip("\n").split("\n") + lines[node.end_lineno:])


def set_owner_audit(source, release, old, new):
    current = literal(source, "DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT")
    if not isinstance(current, dict):
        fail(f"DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT is {current!r}, not a dict")
    if current.get(release, "missing") != old:
        fail(f"DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT[{release!r}] is {current.get(release, 'missing')!r}, expected {old!r}")
    node = assignment(source, "DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT")
    lines = source.split("\n")
    block = "\n".join(lines[node.lineno - 1:node.end_lineno])
    old_text = "None" if old is None else r"""(?:"%s"|'%s')""" % (re.escape(old), re.escape(old))
    pattern = r"""(?:"%s"|'%s')(\s*:\s*)%s""" % (re.escape(release), re.escape(release), old_text)
    block, count = re.subn(pattern, lambda m: json.dumps(release) + m.group(1) + json.dumps(new), block)
    if count != 1:
        fail(f"DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT: expected one entry {release!r}: {old!r}, found {count}")
    out = "\n".join(lines[:node.lineno - 1] + block.split("\n") + lines[node.end_lineno:])
    if literal(out, "DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT") != {**current, release: new}:
        fail("DEVNET2_OWNER_AUDIT did not change as intended")
    return out


def write_all(changes):
    for path, text in changes.items():
        path.write_text(text)
    print("p0-edit: wrote " + " ".join(str(path) for path in sorted(changes)))


def arbiter(tag, commit, core, hg, date, digest):
    check(tag, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", "ARBITER_TAG")
    check(commit, r"[0-9a-f]{8}", "ARBITER_COMMIT_SHORT")
    check(core, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", "CORE_TAG")
    check(hg, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", "HG_TAG")
    check(date, r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]", "REPLAY_DATE")
    check(digest, r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", "ARBITER_DIGEST")
    if digest == PREVIOUS_ARBITER_DIGEST:
        fail("ARBITER_DIGEST is v0.12.0's digest")
    values = read(SI_VALUES)
    pattern = re.compile(
        r"^    repository: ghcr\.io/sentioxyz/arbiter\n(?:    #.*\n)+    digest: (sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})\n", re.M,
    )
    found = pattern.findall(values)
    if found != [PREVIOUS_ARBITER_DIGEST]:
        fail(f"{SI_VALUES}: expected one arbiter.image block pinned to {PREVIOUS_ARBITER_DIGEST}, found {found}")
    new_values = pattern.sub(
        lambda _: ARBITER_PIN.format(tag=tag, commit=commit, core=core, hg=hg, date=date, digest=digest), values,
    )
    expect_yaml_changes(SI_VALUES, values, new_values, {"arbiter.image.digest": (PREVIOUS_ARBITER_DIGEST, digest)})
    tests = read(TEST_RENDER)
    if literal(tests, "DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST") != PREVIOUS_ARBITER_DIGEST:
        fail(f"DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST is not {PREVIOUS_ARBITER_DIGEST}")
    new_tests = replace_assignment(tests, "DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST", ARBITER_MIRROR.format(digest=digest), True)
    if literal(new_tests, "DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST") != digest:
        fail("DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST did not change as intended")
    write_all({SI_VALUES: new_values, TEST_RENDER: new_tests})


def host(x, commit, digest, hg, core):
    check(x, r"[ab]", "indexer")
    check(commit, r"[0-9a-f]{40}", "SN_COMMIT")
    check(digest, r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", "SN_DIGEST")
    check(hg, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", "HG_TAG")
    check(core, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", "CORE_TAG")
    image = f"ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-{commit}@{digest}"
    tag = f"sha-{commit}@{digest}"
    tests = read(TEST_RENDER)
    if literal(tests, "DEVNET2_STAGE3_SOURCE_IMAGE") != image:
        fail(f"DEVNET2_STAGE3_SOURCE_IMAGE is not {image}: the reviewed image (P0_PR) differs from the ledger")
    changes = {}
    pin = read(PIN[x])
    if yaml.safe_load(pin)["node"]["image"]["tag"] != PREVIOUS_HOST_TAG:
        fail(f"{PIN[x]}: the current pin is not {PREVIOUS_HOST_TAG}")
    template = PIN_A if x == "a" else PIN_B
    changes[PIN[x]] = template.format(commit=commit, digest=digest, hg=hg, core=core)
    expect_yaml_changes(PIN[x], pin, changes[PIN[x]], {"node.image.tag": (PREVIOUS_HOST_TAG, tag)})
    if x == "a":
        example = read(EXAMPLE)
        changes[EXAMPLE] = EXAMPLE_PIN.format(commit=commit, digest=digest, hg=hg, core=core)
        expect_yaml_changes(EXAMPLE, example, changes[EXAMPLE], {"node.image.tag": (PREVIOUS_HOST_TAG, tag)})
        if yaml.safe_load(changes[EXAMPLE]) != yaml.safe_load(changes[PIN[x]]):
            fail(f"{EXAMPLE} and {PIN[x]} would differ")
        name = "FRESH_SOURCE_IMAGE"
        mirror = IMAGE_VALUE.format(name=name, commit=commit, digest=digest)
        with_comment = False
    else:
        name = "INDEXER_B_SOURCE_IMAGE"
        mirror = INDEXER_B_MIRROR + IMAGE_VALUE.format(name=name, commit=commit, digest=digest)
        with_comment = True
    if literal(tests, name) != PREVIOUS_HOST_IMAGE:
        fail(f"{name} is not {PREVIOUS_HOST_IMAGE}")
    tests = replace_assignment(tests, name, mirror, with_comment)
    if literal(tests, name) != image:
        fail(f"{name} did not change as intended")
    changes[TEST_RENDER] = set_owner_audit(tests, RELEASE[x], None, "report")
    overlay = read(OVERLAY[x])
    if "ownerAudit" in overlay or overlay.count(SCHEMA_SOURCE) != 1:
        fail(f"{OVERLAY[x]}: expected one '{SCHEMA_SOURCE.strip()}' line and no ownerAudit key")
    changes[OVERLAY[x]] = overlay.replace(SCHEMA_SOURCE, SCHEMA_SOURCE + REPORT_BLOCK)
    expect_yaml_changes(OVERLAY[x], overlay, changes[OVERLAY[x]], {"storageIntegrity.snode.ownerAudit": (None, "report")})
    write_all(changes)


def monitoring():
    values = read(SI_VALUES)
    lines = values.split("\n")
    tops = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == "monitoring:"]
    if len(tops) != 1:
        fail(f"{SI_VALUES}: expected one top-level 'monitoring:' line, found {len(tops)}")
    end = next((i for i in range(tops[0] + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i] and not lines[i][0].isspace() and not lines[i].startswith("#")), len(lines))
    hits = [i for i in range(tops[0] + 1, end) if re.fullmatch(r"  enabled: false(\s+#.*)?", lines[i])]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        fail(f"{SI_VALUES}: expected one '  enabled: false' line in the monitoring block, found {len(hits)}")
    lines[hits[0]] = "  enabled: true"
    new_values = "\n".join(lines)
    expect_yaml_changes(SI_VALUES, values, new_values, {"monitoring.enabled": (False, True)})
    tests = read(TEST_RENDER)
    if literal(tests, "DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED") is not False:
        fail("DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED is not False")
    tests = replace_assignment(tests, "DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED", "DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED = True", False)
    if literal(tests, "DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED") is not True:
        fail("DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED did not change as intended")
    write_all({SI_VALUES: new_values, TEST_RENDER: tests})


def repair(x):
    check(x, r"[ab]", "indexer")
    overlay = read(OVERLAY[x])
    if overlay.count(REPORT_BLOCK) != 1:
        fail(f"{OVERLAY[x]}: expected exactly the report block of the host commit")
    new_overlay = overlay.replace(REPORT_BLOCK, REPAIR_BLOCK)
    expect_yaml_changes(OVERLAY[x], overlay, new_overlay, {"storageIntegrity.snode.ownerAudit": ("report", "repair")})
    tests = set_owner_audit(read(TEST_RENDER), RELEASE[x], "report", "repair")
    write_all({OVERLAY[x]: new_overlay, TEST_RENDER: tests})


def objects(before, after, *expected):
    def load(path):
        text = Path(path).read_text()
        if not text.strip():
            sys.exit(f"p0-edit: {path} is empty: the render failed; stop: discard any edit with "
                     "'git checkout -- .' in the live checkout before anything else")
        return {f'{d["kind"]}/{d["metadata"]["name"]}': d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(text) if d}
    old, new = load(before), load(after)
    changed = sorted(key for key in old.keys() | new.keys() if old.get(key) != new.get(key))
    print("p0-edit: changed objects: " + (" ".join(changed) or "none"))
    if changed != sorted(expected):
        sys.exit(f"p0-edit: expected exactly {sorted(expected)} to change; stop: discard the edit with "
                 "'git checkout -- .' in the live checkout before anything else")


COMMANDS = {"arbiter": (arbiter, 6), "host": (host, 5), "monitoring": (monitoring, 0), "repair": (repair, 1)}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) >= 5 and sys.argv[1] == "objects":
        objects(*sys.argv[2:])
    elif len(sys.argv) >= 2 and sys.argv[1] in COMMANDS and len(sys.argv) - 2 == COMMANDS[sys.argv[1]][1]:
        COMMANDS[sys.argv[1]][0](*sys.argv[2:])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
```

`p0-partstates.py`, which checks K12's partition conditions on the `si_partstates` output (Steps 14 and 15):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check an owner's partition states for the K12 repair preconditions (Plan S3-B Task 15).

  p0-partstates.py PARTSTATES_JSONL PROMOTION_SEQ_AT_RESTART

Reads the JSON lines si_partstates wrote (runbook §7 and §10; any nesting, keys
in snake_case or Go field names) and, for every partition entry (an object with
a table id and a partition id), requires inventory_unrefreshed false; per table
it prints the newest last_acked_promotion_seq and requires it above the
PromotionSeq read when the owner's SNode last restarted. An empty file means
the owner has no partition the arbiter acknowledged (no SI table promoted yet).
"""

import json
import re
import sys


def norm(key):
    return re.sub(r"[_-]", "", key).lower()


def entries(node):
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        keys = {norm(key): value for key, value in node.items()}
        if "tableid" in keys and "partitionid" in keys:
            yield keys
        for value in node.values():
            yield from entries(value)
    elif isinstance(node, list):
        for value in node:
            yield from entries(value)


def main(path, base):
    base = int(base)
    newest, unrefreshed = {}, []
    with open(path) as lines:
        for number, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            try:
                document = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as err:
                sys.exit(f"p0-partstates: {path}:{number} is not JSON: {err}")
            for entry in entries(document):
                table = entry["tableid"]
                seq = int(entry.get("lastackedpromotionseq") or 0)
                newest[table] = max(newest.get(table, 0), seq)
                if str(entry.get("inventoryunrefreshed")).lower() == "true":
                    unrefreshed.append(f'{table}/{entry["partitionid"]}')
    for table in sorted(newest):
        print(f"{table}: newest acknowledged promotion {newest[table]} (restart at {base})")
    if unrefreshed:
        sys.exit("p0-partstates: inventory_unrefreshed true on " + " ".join(unrefreshed))
    stale = [table for table in sorted(newest) if newest[table] <= base]
    if stale:
        sys.exit("p0-partstates: no promotion acknowledged since the restart for " + " ".join(stale))
    print(f"p0-partstates: {len(newest)} table(s), none unrefreshed, each promoted since the restart")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    main(*sys.argv[1:])
```

`p0-record.py`, which checks the evidence and builds the P0 run record that Step 17 writes into Appendix C:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the P0 run record for Plan S3-B's Appendix C (Task 15, Step 17).

  p0-record.py SI_BACKUP DATE PARAGRAPH_FILE OUT_FILE

Checks every evidence file of contract §9 under SI_BACKUP and that
delivery-probe.txt holds one firing and one resolved permalink line (K13), then
writes OUT_FILE: the agent's paragraph (PARAGRAPH_FILE, one paragraph of facts
read from the evidence, starting with the run's first date and ending date
DATE, which is P0_END) followed by the evidence file list, as one paragraph.
`s3b-ledger.py set` puts OUT_FILE into the run-record item "P0 run (Task 15)"
together with P0_END (contract §15). Writes nothing on a refusal.
"""

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

EVIDENCE = (
    [f"preflight-reserved-{host}.tsv" for host in ("a", "b", "v1", "v2", "v3")]
    + ["replay-baseline"]
    + [f"digest-{i}-{build}.txt" for i in (0, 1, 2) for build in ("old", "new")]
    + ["stage3-verifiers-commit", "stage3-indexer-a-commit", "stage3-indexer-b-commit", "voter-order", "holds-readonly.txt"]
    + [f"partstates-{x}.jsonl" for x in ("a", "b")]
    + [f"audit-{x}-soak.txt" for x in ("a", "b")]
    + ["delivery-probe.txt", "stage3-monitoring-commit", "stage3-repair-b-commit", "stage3-repair-a-commit", "p0-end.txt"]
)


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"p0-record: {message}; nothing was written")


def main(backup, date, paragraph_file, out_file):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]", date):
        fail(f"DATE {date!r} is not YYYY-MM-DD")
    missing = [name for name in EVIDENCE if not (Path(backup) / name).is_file()]
    if missing:
        fail(f"evidence missing under {backup}: {' '.join(missing)}")
    probe = (Path(backup) / "delivery-probe.txt").read_text().splitlines()
    for event in ("firing", "resolved"):
        if len([line for line in probe if re.fullmatch(r"\S+ %s https://\S+" % event, line)]) != 1:
            fail(f"delivery-probe.txt holds no single '<UTC time> {event} <permalink>' line (K13)")
    paragraph = " ".join(Path(paragraph_file).read_text().split())
    if not re.match(r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9] to %s UTC: " % re.escape(date), paragraph):
        fail(f"{paragraph_file} must start '<first date> to {date} UTC: '")
    if Path(out_file).exists():
        fail(f"{out_file} exists already (an earlier attempt): stop and ask")
    evidence = ", ".join(f"`{name}`" for name in EVIDENCE)
    Path(out_file).write_text(f"{paragraph} Evidence under `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p0`: {evidence}.\n")
    print(f"p0-record: the P0 run record for P0_END {date} written to {out_file}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 5:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    main(*sys.argv[1:])
```

`p0-user-block.sh`, which runs one of the `devuser1` owner's runbook blocks in the user's own terminal (Steps 13, 14 and 16; the user starts it from fish):

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Run one devuser1 block of docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md in the user's own terminal (Plan S3-B Task 15).
#
#   bash ~/si-devnet2-stage3-p0/p0-user-block.sh <evidence file> <key file of devuser1's owner>
#
# From fish this is an ordinary command. <evidence file> names the block: the confirmed block of
# the live checkout's runbook whose first line is key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key and which
# tees into "$si_backup/<evidence file>" (s3p0-create.txt, s3p0-insert.txt, repair-b-promotion.txt,
# s3p0-drop.txt). The block runs verbatim in a bash with set -eo pipefail, the session helpers
# (helpers.sh) defined and the live checkout as its directory; only its first line is replaced by
# the key file path given here. si_agent_start reads the key into HOUSEGATE_AGENT_KEY: it never
# reaches argv, this terminal or the chat. The block as run is kept as $si_backup/user-<evidence
# file>.sh; a block whose evidence file exists already is refused (a write is never re-run).
# shellcheck disable=SC2154  # si_backup and P come from helpers.sh
set -eo pipefail
[ "$#" = 2 ] || { echo "usage: bash ~/si-devnet2-stage3-p0/p0-user-block.sh <evidence file> <key file>"; exit 2; }
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p0/helpers.sh"
case "$1" in s3p0-create.txt|s3p0-insert.txt|repair-b-promotion.txt|s3p0-drop.txt) ;; *) echo "$1 is not one of the runbook's devuser1 blocks"; exit 2;; esac
[ ! -e "$si_backup/$1" ] || { echo "$si_backup/$1 exists: that write ran already; never re-run it (read the file instead)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$2" ] && [ -r "$2" ] || { echo "$2 is not a readable key file"; exit 1; }
key="$(cd "$(dirname "$2")" && pwd)/$(basename "$2")"
block="$si_backup/user-$1.sh"
python3 -I - "$P/docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p0.md" "$1" "$key" "$block" <<'PY'
import re
import shlex
import sys

runbook, evidence, key, out = sys.argv[1:]
first = "key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key"
# The runbook's bash blocks, found by their fences line by line (decision D24), as p0-helpers.py does.
bash, fence, body = [], None, None
for line in open(runbook).read().split("\n"):
    if fence is None:
        opening = re.match(r"(`{3,})([^`\s]*)\s*$", line)
        if opening:
            fence, body = opening.group(1), ([] if opening.group(2) == "bash" else None)
    elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
        if body is not None:
            bash.append(body)
        fence, body = None, None
    elif body is not None:
        body.append(line)
blocks = [b for b in bash if b and b[0] == first and any(('"$si_backup/%s"' % evidence) in line for line in b)]
if len(blocks) != 1:
    sys.exit("p0-user-block: expected one devuser1 block of the runbook teeing into %s, found %d" % (evidence, len(blocks)))
with open(out, "w") as f:
    f.write("key_file=%s\n%s\n" % (shlex.quote(key), "\n".join(blocks[0][1:])))
PY
chmod 600 "$block"
cd "$P"
echo "running the runbook block that writes \$si_backup/$1 (kept as $block)"
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
source "$block"
```

Then assemble `helpers.sh` and check it:

```bash
P='<path from the JSON>'   # the same path as above

cat >> "$b/helpers.sh" <<'SH'
# --- Plan S3-B Task 15 helpers (not part of the runbook); P is the live checkout, a detached HEAD at origin/main
p0_fresh_main() { # before every commit and every revert: the live checkout fast-forwarded to a freshly fetched origin/main, detached and clean
  git -C "$P" fetch -q origin main || return 1
  [ -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)" ] || { echo "the live checkout has local changes: stop"; return 1; }
  git -C "$P" merge -q --ff-only origin/main || { echo "the live checkout cannot fast-forward to origin/main: stop"; return 1; }
  [ "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse origin/main)" ] || { echo "the live checkout is not at origin/main (an unpushed local commit?): stop"; return 1; }
  [ "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" = HEAD ] || { echo "the live checkout is on a branch, not a detached HEAD: stop"; return 1; }
  echo "live checkout at origin/main $(git -C "$P" rev-parse --short=9 HEAD) (detached)"
}
p0_render() { # $1 release of the SI helmfile: its full render from the live checkout (local, no cluster access)
  (cd "$P" && helmfile -f k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml template --selector "name=$1" --skip-deps 2>/dev/null)
}
p0_tests() { # $1 label: the render tests must pass and run the test count recorded in Step 2
  local out want
  want="$(cat "$si_backup/render-baseline.txt")"
  out="$(cd "$P" && python3 -B charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py 2>&1 | tail -3)" || true
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tee "$si_backup/render-$1.txt"
  if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx OK && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qF "$want "; then return 0; fi
  echo "the render tests failed or did not run as '$want': stop"
  return 1
}
p0_changed_files() { # $@ the files the working tree may change, exactly
  local got want
  got="$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain | sed 's/^...//' | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')"
  want="$(printf '%s\n' "$@" | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')"
  [ "$got" = "$want" ] || { echo "changed files: ${got:-none}; expected: $want; stop"; return 1; }
}
p0_k12() { # $1 a|b: Plan S3-B K12 for that owner, read-only, from the runbook's own evidence once runbook §10's precondition block passed; one PASS line per condition, fails at the first unmet one
  local x="$1" pre rec_started rec_restarts rec_seq now_started now_restarts start_s mon leader_at from age a now_fsm fsm_base samples f
  case "$x" in a|b) ;; *) echo "usage: p0_k12 a|b"; return 2;; esac
  set -a
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  . "$si_backup/ledger.env"
  set +a
  pre="$si_backup/repair-preconditions-$x.txt"
  grep -qx "indexer-$x meets the repair preconditions (K12)" "$pre" 2>/dev/null && [ -n "$(find "$pre" -mmin -60)" ] ||
    { echo "K12: runbook §10's precondition block for indexer-$x did not pass within the last hour: run it first: stop"; return 1; }
  [ "$(si_images | awk '$1 ~ /^storage-integrity-si-v2-arbiter-[0-9]/ {sub(/.*@/, "", $3); print $3}' | LC_ALL=C sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $1, $2}')" = "3 $ARBITER_DIGEST" ] ||
    { echo "K12: not every voter runs $ARBITER_DIGEST: stop"; return 1; }
  echo "K12 PASS 1/7: runbook §10's precondition block passed; every voter runs $ARBITER_DIGEST"
  for f in k9-record.txt mechanics-record.txt; do
    grep -qF "mechanics: 13 test(s) passed on us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/sentio-352722/sentio/clickhouse-server:26.3-lts-decimal512-release-2026-09-16" "$si_backup/$f" &&
      grep -qF "snode: TestOwnerAuditRepairsResurrectedPartsAcrossAClickHouseRestart passed on us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/sentio-352722/sentio/clickhouse-server:26.3-lts-decimal512-release-2026-09-16" "$si_backup/$f" ||
      { echo "K12: $f does not hold both deployed-image PASS lines (K9): stop"; return 1; }
  done
  echo "K12 PASS 2/7: deployed-image mechanics recorded (ledger and runbook §1.3)"
  read -r rec_started rec_restarts rec_seq < "$si_backup/restart-$x" || { echo "K12: no restart record restart-$x (runbook §5): stop"; return 1; }
  read -r now_started now_restarts < <(si_host_started "$x")
  [ "$now_started $now_restarts" = "$rec_started $rec_restarts" ] ||
    { echo "K12: indexer-$x restarted after its restart record ($rec_started $rec_restarts, now $now_started $now_restarts): its soak starts over (runbook §9): stop"; return 1; }
  start_s="$(si_epoch "$rec_started")"; mon="$(cat "$si_backup/monitoring-synced-at")"; leader_at="$(cat "$si_backup/leader-replaced-at")"
  from="$start_s"; [ "$mon" -le "$from" ] || from="$mon"
  age=$(( $(date -u +%s) - from ))
  [ "$age" -ge 86400 ] || { echo "K12: $((age / 3600)) h since the later of indexer-$x's restart ($rec_started) and the monitoring sync; report mode needs 24 h: wait"; return 1; }
  echo "K12 PASS 3/7: report mode for $((age / 3600)) h since the later of the restart ($rec_started) and the monitoring sync, no restart since"
  a="$(si_audit "$x")"
  printf '%s\n' "$a" > "$si_backup/k12-$x-audit.txt"
  printf '%s\n' "$a" | grep -qx 'sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_mode{mode="report"} 1' ||
    { echo "K12: indexer-$x does not run owner_audit report: stop"; return 1; }
  [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables)" = 0 ] ||
    { echo "K12: indexer-$x has unclean tables now: stop (K12: explain the finding first)"; return 1; }
  samples="$(sed -n 's/^sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables //p' "$si_backup/audit-$x-soak.txt" 2>/dev/null)" || samples=""
  [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | grep -c .)" -ge 2 ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | LC_ALL=C sort -u)" = 0 ] ||
    { echo "K12: audit-$x-soak.txt holds fewer than two samples or an unclean one: stop"; return 1; }
  for f in alerts-during-soak.txt alerts-before-repair-a.txt; do
    [ "$x" = a ] || [ "$f" = alerts-during-soak.txt ] || continue
    [ "$(head -1 "$si_backup/$f" 2>/dev/null)" = none ] ||
      { echo "K12: $f does not read 'none' (the user's reading of #alerts): explain every message first: stop"; return 1; }
  done
  echo "K12 PASS 4/7: unclean_tables 0 now and in all $(printf '%s\n' "$samples" | grep -c .) soak samples; no alert message in #alerts"
  now_fsm="$(printf '%s\n' "$a" | si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_fsm_unavailable_total || true)"
  if [ "$start_s" -gt "$leader_at" ]; then fsm_base=0; else fsm_base="$(si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_fsm_unavailable_total < "$si_backup/audit-$x-after-leader.txt" || true)"; fi
  [ -n "$now_fsm" ] && [ "$now_fsm" = "$fsm_base" ] ||
    { echo "K12: fsm_unavailable_total moved from ${fsm_base:-unknown} (after the leader replacement) to ${now_fsm:-unknown}: stop"; return 1; }
  echo "K12 PASS 5/7: fsm_unavailable_total flat at $now_fsm since the leader replacement"
  [ -n "$(find "$si_backup/partstates-$x.jsonl" -mmin -60 2>/dev/null)" ] ||
    { echo "K12: partstates-$x.jsonl is missing or older than an hour: run runbook §10's precondition block first: stop"; return 1; }
  python3 -I "$si_backup/p0-partstates.py" "$si_backup/partstates-$x.jsonl" "$rec_seq" || { echo "K12: stop"; return 1; }
  echo "K12 PASS 6/7 and 7/7: every SI table of indexer-$x with partition state promoted since the restart (runbook §10 checked the Active ones); no partition with inventory_unrefreshed"
}
SH
printf 'P=%q\n' "$P" >> "$b/helpers.sh"
chmod 600 "$b/helpers.sh"
```
